**Daily Devotional**

**February 26**

*20 And he said, Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.(Exodus 33:20 KJV)*

This is where Moses asked God to let him see Him. It is so amazing that God had such close fellowship with Moses that they talked to each other as friends and that God tried to give Moses everything that he asked for. How awesome would it be to see any part of God with our human eyes? Remember that God is a Spirit (John 4:24), and you sure would have to be in the spirit to see any part of God.

God did not mean that He would kill Moses if Moses saw His face, but the problem is that us humans cannot be exposed to the Glory of God without it killing us. Just like mold will die if exposed to light, we humans could not live in the presence of the pure light of God (John 1:9). It will be so wonderful to get our glorified, spiritual, bodies some day, and be able to see and visit face to face with Jesus and Father God, as well as Moses, John the Baptist, Abraham and all the Old Testament Prophets and saints. Just imagine being able to talk with all the Old Testament prophets. Thank you Lord for redeeming us.
